message.content: In Christian theology, Jesus Christ is regarded as the central figure—often seen as the fulfillment of the prophetic tradition rather than just another prophet. However, many Christians also hold the prophets of the Hebrew Bible (such as Moses, Isaiah, Jeremiah, and others) in high esteem for their foundational role in revealing God’s will and preparing the way for Jesus. John the Baptist is another key prophetic figure who is celebrated for announcing the coming of the Messiah. Different Christian traditions may emphasize various prophets differently, but overall the prophetic lineage is viewed as integral to the faith, with Jesus ultimately seen as the culmination of that prophetic line.
